def _create_overdue_order(event, code, **kwargs):
    return Order.objects.create(
        code=code, event=event, email='dummy@dummy.test', status=Order.STATUS_PENDING,
        datetime=now() - timedelta(days=10), expires=now() - timedelta(days=1),
        total=Decimal('23.00'), locale='en',
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        **kwargs
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_is_registered_as_periodic_task():
    assert expire_orders in periodic_task._live_receivers(None)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_expires_overdue_pending_order(event):
    o = _create_overdue_order(event, 'OVERDUE')
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert o.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.expired').exists()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_respects_disabled_setting(event):
    event.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
    o = _create_overdue_order(event, 'NOEXP')
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_setting_is_per_event(event):
    other = Event.objects.create(
        organizer=event.organizer, name='Other', slug='other', date_from=now() + timedelta(days=2),
    )
    other.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = False
    o1 = _create_overdue_order(event, 'EVA')
    o2 = _create_overdue_order(other, 'EVB')
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o1.refresh_from_db()
    o2.refresh_from_db()
    assert o1.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert o2.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_future_deadline(event):
    o = _create_overdue_order(event, 'FUTURE', expires=now() + timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_valid_if_pending(event):
    o = _create_overdue_order(event, 'VALIDPEND', valid_if_pending=True)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_require_approval(event):
    o = _create_overdue_order(event, 'APPROVAL', require_approval=True)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_order_with_cancellation_fee(event):
    o = _create_overdue_order(event, 'CANCFEE')
    OrderFee.objects.create(order=o, fee_type=OrderFee.FEE_TYPE_CANCELLATION, value=Decimal('2.00'))
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_ignores_paid_orders(event):
    o = _create_overdue_order(event, 'PAID', status=Order.STATUS_PAID)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.status == Order.STATUS_PAID


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_continues_after_error(event, monkeypatch):
    o1 = _create_overdue_order(event, 'FAILING')
    o2 = _create_overdue_order(event, 'WORKING')
    original = mark_order_expired

    def failing(order, *args, **kwargs):
        if order.pk == o1.pk:
            raise Exception('boom')
        return original(order, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr('pretix.base.services.orders.mark_order_expired', failing)
    expire_orders(sender=event)
    o1.refresh_from_db()
    o2.refresh_from_db()
    assert o1.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
    assert o2.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
EOF
